O_PREVIOUS_status: inherited component reference (previous occupation-only J_TRUST epoch 10, income zero residual); not a fresh equally trained two-adapter control

attack_slate.aliases: every service fits all three views directly; exact wire aliases (e.g. RAW income inside O_PREVIOUS and HYB_RI_JO) are recorded by hash and never used to drop or replace a fit

control_criteria.shuffle: max two-sided shuffled envelope vs group-permuted INNER SEX (INNER_NULL_SEED) <= 0.60

attack_slate.controls: per seed x view (r1, r2, pair): 18-reader banks with group-permuted ATT SEX (ATT_NULL_SEED) and with an appended true-SEX bit (planted) on the RAW_PROJ wire; never removed after seeing recovery
attack_slate.envelope: max over all 18 (pair: 18 + 36 ignore aliases), reselected inside each bootstrap draw

fit_accounting.arithmetic: 18 readers x 3 views x 10 services x 2 seeds = 1080; 18 readers x 3 views x 2 banks x 2 seeds = 216; the handoff total is used as written (no known-wrong planned total)

attack_slate.readers: inherited complete-view 18 (9 base attacks.READERS + 9 extended LOGITS_OUTPUT/DECISION/CONFIDENCE x LR/MLP/HGB)
attack_slate.training: ATT train groups (inherited split), SEX; orientation on ATT validation groups only; INNER label-free scoring
views: pair 50 with explicit IGNORE_r1 (ignore-income) and IGNORE_r2 (ignore-occupation) readers as exact local aliases

bank.S12_S21_note: learned sequential controls; not implementations of any published finite-law sequential algorithm
bank.hybrid_rule: built from J_BOTH's audited checkpoint (its FIT2 nominee, else the fixed epoch-10 diagnostic) in each seed; fixed wire substitutions, not trained arms or information-theoretic proofs

hybrids.HYB_RI_JO: RAW_PROJ (zero) income + J_BOTH audited occupation residual

engineering_tests: TRA_ENGINEERING_TESTS_V2: 16 passed (synthetic, queued). Supersedes V1 (14 passed) after math-review test additions: non-empty counterfactual scans, scans do not disturb J_BOTH, accepted simultaneous macro-step order independence, per-recipient gradient and finite-difference checks.
exposure_statement: Exploratory development on repeatedly used Adult people. Source models were trained on all FIT. All people are treated as repeatedly used development data. Intervals are conditional on the fitted models and readers and do not account for the adaptive research history; the two model seeds reuse the same people.

F1_J_BOTH_has_point_feasible_FIT2_nomine.reason: Per-recipient KL<=0.001 kept the previous occupation adapter point-feasible; income headroom on FIT2 is >=0.0032 Brier and >=0.0074 NLL vs U0, but seed-0 occupation headroom is only ~0.0023 Brier and the joint objective may push both recipients at once.

F2_J_BOTH_pair_benefit_vs_RAW_PROJ_lower.reason: Occupation-only gave 0.0049 with upper bound 0.0115; a 65-parameter rank-1 income correction under KL<=0.001 is unlikely to add more than ~0.015 of established coalition reduction.

F3_J_BOTH_beats_L_BOTH_S12_and_S21_on_pa.reason: Coupling added nothing measurable before; sequential and simultaneous joint objectives should land in similar trust regions.

F4_I_ONLY_establishes_a_pair_reduction_v.reason: Income predictions carry SEX signal, but the rank-1 KL-bounded change is small and fresh nonlinear readers recover much of what critics miss.

F5_all_12_J_BOTH_income_utility_clauses_.reason: Previous income upper bounds reached 0.012-0.022 mostly from reference and sampling variance, which a small income correction cannot shrink.

F6_D14_adding_changed_income_to_changed_.reason: The combination test is direct, but the income change is tightly bounded.

forecasts.note: Predictions, not gates; never revised after outcomes.

primary_family.K_rule: 24 candidate INNER utility clauses + 3 privacy endpoints per registered comparator = 39 always; an ineligible or unavailable comparator keeps its visible slot (status INCOMPLETE_COMPARATOR_INELIGIBLE) and the dependent competitive claim is incomplete
also_required: meaningful privacy-driven movement in both recipient adapters and both seeds (recipe.privacy_movement.meaningful_rule) at or before the nominated checkpoint
primary_family.candidate: J_BOTH (FIT2 nominee; if none, the fixed epoch-10 diagnostic and the whole primary family is diagnostic)
primary_family.comparator_eligibility: RAW_PROJ: its 24 FIT2 point clauses; arms: POINT_FEASIBLE_NOMINEE at FIT2; frozen at SELECTION_LOCK
primary_family.control_gate_failure: privacy endpoints NOT_ESTIMABLE (scoring validity), not protection

privacy_endpoints.pair: benefit AUC_control - AUC_candidate, paired-seed mean, lower simultaneous bound > 0.020
privacy_endpoints.r1: income excess AUC_candidate - AUC_control, upper bound <= 0.010

primary_family.utility_endpoints: per seed, task, reference, metric: mean INNER difference, upper simultaneous bound <= cap

adapter_contract.decision_rule: argmax probabilities; first class in fixed source order
adapter_contract.hidden_layer: enc.i modules 0..3 (Linear 83->64, ReLU, Linear 64->64, ReLU): final 64-d activation before enc.i.4 (Linear 64->16)
adapter_contract.nominal_layout: projected representation(16), own centered logits(K), own probabilities(K), own decision(1)
adapter_contract.per_recipient: z_i = (q0_i + hbar64_i R_i^T + b_i) B_i with q0_i = float64(z0_i) B_i^T; frozen folded own head i outputs
adapter_contract.scale_rule: s_i = max(1, sqrt(mean_x ||h64_i(x)||^2 / 64)) over the authorized fitting pool (UPDATE+GUARD, 10223 rows), float64

budgets.anchor: exact zero-residual start of each recipient; never reset (including at the sequential phase boundary)
budgets.disclosure: empirical fitting constraints, not held-out utility guarantees; KL initial gradient is zero and never chooses a coefficient
budgets.kl: mean_x KL(p0_i(x)||p_theta_i(x)) with immutable zero-residual p0_i

recipe.critic_round: one Adam step for each of the 9 critics on one fresh UPDATE minibatch of the current complete wires
recipe.finite_acceptance: recompute that recipient full-pool NLL, Brier, correct and K after real update; NLL/Brier/K <= limit + 1e-10
recipe.frozen_checks: all source tensors bitwise after every step; inactive recipient residual bitwise unchanged after every step
recipe.full_pool_reduction: float64 sum of per-chunk row-sum losses in fixed row order, divided by pool rows
recipe.initialization: R_i = 0, b_i = 0 exactly (zero-residual witness = RAW_PROJ for both recipients)
recipe.no_sweeps: no lambda, KL, temperature, capacity, trust, head architecture, mask, calibration, controller or refitted-critic family; no extra epochs for rejected steps

normalization.coefficients: lambda_J_i from the joint objective (J_BOTH, S12, S21, I_ONLY); lambda_L_i from the local objective (L_BOTH); T_BOTH none
normalization.disclosure: equal target ratio does not imply equal force; achieved per-step strength ratios are logged
normalization.statistic: median gradient norm over draws at the matched warm zero-residual state
normalization.task_gradient: shared UPDATE-minibatch plus whole-GUARD task objective of that recipient
normalization.unavailable_if: median nonfinite or <=1e-12, or coefficient > 1e4; recorded, no search

recipe.per_recipient_gradient: gradient of the arm objective w.r.t. that recipient residual only (joint: own view + pair; local: own view)

privacy_movement.active_budget_states: J_BOTH: first 16 accepted updates per recipient whose projection had an active halfspace or whose ladder shortened, with their privacy-removed re-solve
privacy_movement.counterfactual_rule: at saved pre-step state remove that recipient applied privacy gradient; identical task gradient, pool metrics/gradients, budgets, solver and ladder
privacy_movement.counterfactual_scope: J_BOTH first eight accepted nonzero updates per recipient per seed, in update order
privacy_movement.meaningful_rule: for each seed and recipient, at least 6 of the 8 counterfactuals change the deployed probe wire beyond tolerance and the displacement beyond noise; all at or before the nominated (or fixed epoch-10) checkpoint
privacy_movement.probe: inherited fixed 512-row UPDATE probe (label-independent SHA256 order; same rows both seeds)
privacy_movement.wire_tolerance: per recipient: max(1e-10, 10*measured repeat-forward max abs noise) per coordinate block; any decision change counts

recipe.qp: per recipient: min ||d-p||^2 s.t. g_NLL.d<=s_NLL, g_Brier.d<=s_Brier, g_K.d<=s_K, ||d||<=0.01; exact KKT active-set enumeration
recipe.reference_refresh: initial and at each epoch start (each phase)

roles.critic_data: UPDATE rows and UPDATE SEX only (GUARD has no SEX export)
roles.task_labels: income and occupation labels for UPDATE and GUARD (new authorized export)
roles.task_pool: inherited UPDATE (8180) + GUARD (2043) = 10223 rows; FIT folds 0/1

recipe.sensitive_risk_per_view: 1 - min(critic CEs, SEX entropy)/SEX entropy (best-of-bank, entropy normalized)
recipe.sequential_rule: first recipient receives 320 opportunities (10 epochs) while the second stays at its zero residual; the first is then frozen bitwise and the second receives 320 opportunities against the fixed first release; anchors are never reset
recipe.simultaneous_rule: both proposals computed from the same pre-update state (same minibatch rows, same critic state); each recipient projected/accepted on its own separable budgets; applied together as one recorded macro-step
recipe.single_rule: I_ONLY adapts income for 320 opportunities; occupation stays the exact RAW_PROJ zero residual
recipe.slack_rule: slack < -1e-10 is an infeasible current state (zero step); [-1e-10,0) resolved to 0 and logged
recipe.task_objective: per task: (8180/10223)*mean CE(current UPDATE minibatch) + (2043/10223)*mean CE(whole GUARD pool)
recipe.trainable: per recipient R_i (rank_i x 64) and b_i (rank_i) only; every source tensor, both heads, bases, class orders and preprocessing frozen

interpretation_limits: local improvement is not coalition improvement
coalition improvement over task-only is not joint-design advantage unless it also beats L_BOTH, S12 and S21
changed income does not erase old uncertainty; its new clauses are computed

selection_rule.no_feasible: NO_POINT_FEASIBLE_NOMINEE; the fixed epoch-10 (sequential P2E10) checkpoint is attacked as a clearly ineligible diagnostic
selection_rule.per_arm: latest common positive checkpoint passing all 24 ORIGINAL POINT clauses (income+occupation x U0/Ucal x accuracy loss<=.010, NLL excess<=.010, summed Brier excess<=.005 x both seeds); sequential arms: second-phase checkpoints only, both recipient metrics qualifying together
selection_rule.role: FIT2 (inherited FIT fold 2, 5211 rows), exposed development selection role, opened once after TRAINING_COMPLETE_LOCK
